from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    candidates = [(counts[row[0]], "row", i) for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    candidates += [(counts[grid[0][j]], "col", j) for j in range(w) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1]
    _, axis, index = min(candidates)
    if axis == "row":
        a, b = grid[:index], grid[index + 1:]
        height, width = len(a), w
    else:
        a, b = [row[:index] for row in grid], [row[index + 1:] for row in grid]
        height, width = h, len(a[0])
    common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    color = next(iter(common))
    if color == 9:
        color = 2
    return [[3 if a[i][j] == color and b[i][j] == color else color
             for j in range(width)] for i in range(height)]
